confirm.title: openpublictransport.net community server shut down
confirm.description:
We had to shut down our own API at {server} for cost reasons. The following entries and their entities were removed: {entries}.

To set your stops up again, use the official provider of your transit network (e.g. VRR, KVV, MVV, VVS, RMV, HVV, BVG, VVO), or host the same server yourself (Docker image {image}) and connect it with the "OTP2 — Eigene Instanz" provider.

From now on, we focus on connecting more transit networks directly. Missing yours? Request it on GitHub. Full background: {url}

Confirm to dismiss this notice.
